description: FREE headline pre-check (100/day per wallet; pass caller). Returns assessability only - whether the URL is in-policy; the endpoint is not probed and no grade is returned. The full signed report is the paid rail_probe_probe call.

caller.description: Solana base58 wallet of the operator; keys the free allowance (100/day per wallet).

url.description: The one endpoint URL the 7-probe set runs against after payment. Probe responses are processed in memory only and never stored.

name: rail_probe_precheck
